reviewer_checklist.prompt: Is the behavior implemented behind a stable contract instead of ad hoc route, MCP, or UI-only behavior?
required_evidence: action id or typed route contract

reviewer_checklist.prompt: Do tests cover success and failure behavior where applicable?
Could this touch Redis, PostgreSQL, staging, factories, or test storage?
required_evidence: no Redis DB 0/public PG use in tests

reviewer_checklist.prompt: Does the change affect broad Workflow Engine behavior, deploy, runtime, connectors, or release claims?
required_evidence: live staging smoke or time-boxed waiver

reviewer_checklist.prompt: Is rollback/recovery bounded by the #750 runtime runbook?
required_evidence: scenario id from docs/workflow-runtime-rollback-recovery.json when runtime state changes

reviewer_checklist.prompt: Can the change route work, waits, subscriptions, or dispatch effects to closed/terminal cases?
required_evidence: terminal-case negative test or explicit non-applicability note

reviewer_checklist.prompt: Do user-visible mutations go through Action Spine or an accepted compatibility route with matching auth/audit?
Is the release-gate evidence linked back to parent #686?
required_evidence: GitHub comment on #686 or child issue receipt

required_contracts: frontend source of truth in frontend/src
Action Spine action for durable mutation
production_only: production-smoke only for normal production release or deployed UI change
required_artifacts: Playwright report or explicit backend-only note
blockers: UI mutation bypasses durable Action Spine contract
constructor/editor behavior diverges between frontend/src and module wrapper
no negative test for invalid schema/patch when applicable
warnings: browser tier not applicable to docs-only or backend-only patch

blockers: terminal cases can receive new work

production_only: production-smoke only when deployed action affects production runtime
blockers: unknown or planned action exposed as executable
mutation bypasses /act or accepted compatibility executor
warnings: read-only inspect action has no audit by policy

blockers: deploy creates subscriptions for invalid definition
validation receipt lacks stable blocking error codes
warnings: live staging unavailable with time-boxed waiver

blockers: tests touch Redis DB 0 or public PG

warnings: external connector disabled by staging-core default

production_only: none unless release notes/tag are created
blockers: operator behavior changes without runbook link
warnings: production preflight not required for docs-only change

waiver_template: Workflow constructor/runtime checklist waiver for #<issue>: skipped gate(s)=<list>; reason=<why safe>; replacement evidence=<commands/artifacts>; risk accepted=<runtime/user/data impact>; rollback owner/command=<owner + command>; expires=<date/time>.

dispatch_escalation.specialist_qa: Use Shino/Hinata only when Shikadai explicitly requests state:ready-for-test for QA-heavy, release, browser, or regression scope.
dispatch_escalation.hinata: bounded browser/TestBench execution from reviewer-approved plan
